result.markdown:
# Grand Tunis Sites Outage Caused by Fiber Link Failure

- **Classification:** incident
- **Root cause:** transport_failure at `LNK-TUN-01-A`
- **Confidence:** medium (Direct evidence of site down alarms on the shared fiber link, with checked and ruled out changes and external events.)
- **Impact:** 2026-09-27 15:30 to 2026-09-27 20:30
- **Cause time:** 2026-09-27 15:41
- **Affected:** S-TUN-003, S-TUN-012, S-TUN-018

## Summary

A transport failure on the shared fiber link LNK-TUN-01-A caused simultaneous site outages for three sites.

Traffic, active users, and availability dropped on three sites in Grand Tunis from 15:30 to 20:30.

## Timeline

- 2026-09-27 15:30: Traffic, active users and availability drop started on 3 sites. [ALR-0034]
- 2026-09-27 15:41: Critical SITE_DOWN alarm raised on S-TUN-018. [ALM-000479]
- 2026-09-27 15:41: Critical SITE_DOWN alarm raised on S-TUN-012. [ALM-000480]
- 2026-09-27 15:41: Critical SITE_DOWN alarm raised on S-TUN-003. [ALM-000481]
- 2026-09-27 20:22: SITE_DOWN alarm cleared on S-TUN-012. [ALM-000480]
- 2026-09-27 20:23: SITE_DOWN alarms cleared on S-TUN-018 and S-TUN-003, resolving the incident. [ALM-000479, ALM-000481, ALR-0034]

## Evidence

- Sites S-TUN-003, S-TUN-012, and S-TUN-018 experienced a traffic, active users, and availability drop starting at 2026-09-27 15:30. [ALR-0034]
- All three affected sites share the exact same fiber link LNK-TUN-01-A connected to aggregation router AGG-TUN-01. [T4, T10]
- Critical SITE_DOWN alarms occurred simultaneously across all three sites starting at 2026-09-27 15:41. [ALM-000479, ALM-000480, ALM-000481]
- No changes were executed on the affected sites or their parents between 2026-09-27 15:00 and 2026-09-27 20:30. [T3]
- No maintenance windows or external events were scheduled or registered during the incident window. [T8, T9]

## Hypotheses

1. **transport_failure** at LNK-TUN-01-A: confirmed. All affected sites share the fiber link LNK-TUN-01-A, went down simultaneously, and recovered together without any changes or external events. [T4, T10, ALM-000479, ALM-000480, ALM-000481]
2. **bad_change**: rejected. No changes were recorded on the affected sites and their parent nodes during the relevant time window. [T3]

## Recommended actions

- Inspect fiber link LNK-TUN-01-A for physical damage or degradation.
- Review transport resilience and backup paths for the aggregation router AGG-TUN-01.

## Sources

- `ALR-0034`: ended alert from 2026-09-27 15:30: 3 site(s) (S-TUN-003, S-TUN-012, S-TUN-018); region-level TUN; metrics: active_users, availability_pct, dl_volume_mb
- `ALM-000479`: critical SITE_DOWN on S-TUN-018, raised 2026-09-27 15:41, cleared 2026-09-27 20:23
- `ALM-000480`: critical SITE_DOWN on S-TUN-012, raised 2026-09-27 15:41, cleared 2026-09-27 20:22
- `ALM-000481`: critical SITE_DOWN on S-TUN-003, raised 2026-09-27 15:41, cleared 2026-09-27 20:23
- `T4`: get_topology(node_id=S-TUN-003, include=all) -> Depends on (child -> parent -> core): S-TUN-003 (site) -> LNK-TUN-01-A (fiber link) -> AGG-TUN-01 (agg router) -> CORE-UPF-01 (core upf)
- `T10`: get_topology(node_id=LNK-TUN-01-A, include=all) -> Depends on (child -> parent -> core): LNK-TUN-01-A (fiber link) -> AGG-TUN-01 (agg router) -> CORE-UPF-01 (core upf)
- `T3`: get_changes(start=2026-09-27 15:00:00, end=2026-09-27 20:30:00, node_ids=['S-TUN-003', 'S-TUN-012', 'S-TUN-018'], include_ancestors=True) -> No changes on S-TUN-003, S-TUN-012, S-TUN-018 and its parents between 2026-09-27 15:00 and 2026-09-27 20:30.
- `T8`: get_maintenance(start=2026-09-27 15:00:00, end=2026-09-27 20:30:00, node_ids=['S-TUN-003', 'S-TUN-012', 'S-TUN-018', 'AGG-TUN-01'], include_ancestors= -> No maintenance window scheduled on S-TUN-003, S-TUN-012, S-TUN-018, AGG-TUN-01 and its parents between 2026-09-27 15:00 and 2026-09-27 20:30.

truth.notes: trap=missing_alarm; Fibre cut on LNK-TUN-01-A; all 3 downstream sites lost service until repair. The LINK_LOS alarm was never raised: only SITE_DOWN alarms on the sites exist. Trap: there is no alarm on LNK-TUN-01-A, only 3 SITE_DOWN alarms on sites, so a hasty investigator names a site or a set of independent site faults. Settled by: get_topology shows that the 3 sites share the parent LNK-TUN-01-A and that nothing else hangs under it; they went down in the same minute and sites on sibling links stayed up, so the shared link is the one cause.
